footprint.symmetry: approximate bilateral symmetry along the central tower axis (towers spaced evenly, left/right mirroring bands)

repeated_patterns: Build repeating horizontal courses: white smooth layer (2 high), narrow stonebrick/gray trim, wood plank band (1 or 2 high), then repeat to reach ~3 floors.
raw_elements: horizontal banded walls (alternating white smooth layer, wood planks, stonebrick/gray strip)
three tall square towers attached to one long side with small glass windows
raised white base platform running around perimeter
flat wood-planked rooftop with stone-slab edging and small crenellations
stone-slab or slab_stone steps/ledges at tower tops
raw_hints: Start with a rectangular base on a raised white border (approx 24x14).
Build repeating horizontal courses: white smooth layer (2 high), narrow stonebrick/gray trim, wood plank band (1 or 2 high), then repeat to reach ~3 floors.
Place three evenly spaced square towers along one long side; towers rise above main roof by ~6 blocks and use stonebrick with small inset glass panes every 2-3 blocks.
Top towers and roof with overhanging wood planks edged by stone slabs; add small fence/stone crenellations along roof perimeter.
Add foundation/detail stones (cobble/brick texture) under the white base for depth.
rebuild_intent.summary: A low-rise rectangular fortress-like building with layered horizontal banding, three tall stone towers along one long face, repeated window bands, and a wood-planked flat upper platform/roof. The structure sits on a raised white base and uses stacked alternating horizontal stripes of smooth white material, light brown wood planks, and gray stone brick accents. Small crenellations and stone-slab edging appear on the rooftop and tower caps.
